session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Gap Down, Double Bottom, Double Top Then Bear Channel'. Session = MLK-holiday Tuesday Jan 20, 2026 (note: 'Moving average calculation includes US holiday Monday trading early close', so the EMA carries Monday's early-close bars). Gap-down open about 6873, lower-low double bottom / bear trap (weak bears) around 6862 rallies to 6901, micro then consecutive double tops all through the morning (red dotted peaks), a Wedge off the 23:45-01:10 recovery, then a broad bear channel of lower highs and lower lows; breakout into a tight bear channel after 02:25 down to 6820, limit-order trading into the close with a 'Sell The Close, Do not buy' note. Axis reads ET+13 hrs (22:30-05:00 = PT 06:30-13:00 shifted); day-change marker prints Jan 21 mid-axis; keep tz suspicion flagged. Inset daily panel: 'Trading Range Breakout'.
